mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, user_name, password_hash, role, status, login_fail_count FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET login_fail_count = 0, locked_at = NULL, status = 'active', last_login_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE users SET login_fail_count = login_fail_count + 1, status = CASE WHEN login_fail_count + 1 >= #{lockThreshold} THEN 'locked' ELSE status END, locked_at = CASE WHEN login_fail_count + 1 >= #{lockThreshold} THEN NOW() ELSE locked_at END WHERE user_id = #{userId}
